integrity: Analytic infinite-dimensional proof with standalone finite-matrix checker. No fabricated publication or independence claims.
scientific_limitations: Complex Hilbert numerical-radius norm; diagonal pure-point unitaries only. Antipodal separation is sufficient for strong-instability witness, not a complete classification of strong extreme points. Prior finite-dimensional extremality criterion is acknowledged, not claimed original. Bibliographic incompleteness remains possible.
title: Maximal midpoint instability of an extreme numerical-radius unitary
